scripts.build: npm run build -w @observatorio/contracts && npm run build -w @observatorio/api && npm run build -w @observatorio/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @observatorio/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @observatorio/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.import:pilot: npm run build -w @observatorio/contracts && npm run import -w @observatorio/importer
scripts.import:national: npm run build -w @observatorio/contracts && npm run national -w @observatorio/importer
scripts.import:exterior: npm run build -w @observatorio/contracts && npm run exterior -w @observatorio/importer
